customCarrier.title: Add Your Own Carrier
customCarrier.subtitle: If your carrier is not in the list, you can connect it yourself via webhook or API.
customCarrier.optionWebhookBody: We'll send confirmed order details to your webhook URL. You can forward it to your carrier using Zapier, Make, or your own server.
customCarrier.optionApiBody: If your carrier has an API, enter the base URL and API key, and we'll call it directly on confirmation.
customCarrier.optionManualBody: If you're not technical, you can export confirmed orders as CSV and upload them manually to your carrier dashboard.
customCarrier.signingSecretHint: Optional. Used to sign the payload.
customCarrier.apiKeyHint: Stored encrypted. Leave blank when editing to keep the current key.
customCarrier.deleteBody: Confirmed orders will no longer be sent to it.
customCarrier.unavailable: Saving is unavailable until the carrier table is installed.
